2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230825083251/https://www.theguardian.com/football/blog/2016/apr/08/mls-kaka-orlando-city-brilliant|url-status=live}}</ref> and was subsequently named [[2016 Major League Soccer season#Weekly awards|Player of the Week]] for his performance.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.mlssoccer.com/post/2016/04/04/2016-team-week-wk-5-kaka-returns-lead-orlando-city-over-champs|title=2016 Team of the Week (Wk 5): Kaká returns to lead Orlando City over 2016, he was included in the roster for the [[2016 MLS All-Star Game]].<ref name="Villa, Pirlo and Kaka headline MLS All-Star squad to face Arsenal">{{cite magazine|url=http://www.fourfourtwo.com/news/villa-pirlo-and-kaka-headline-mls-all-star-squad-face-arsenal|title=Villa, Pirlo and Kaka headline MLS All-Star squad to face 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160719141137/http://www.fourfourtwo.com/news/villa-pirlo-and-kaka-headline-mls-all-star-squad-face-arsenal|url-status=live}}</ref> He finished his second MLS season with the club with 9 goals and 10 assists in 24 appearances,<ref name="Kaká-MLSProfile">{{cite In total, Kaká made 75 league appearances in his three seasons with Orlando, scoring 24 goals and providing 22 assists.<ref name="Fuerza Puerto Rico">{{cite web|url=https://www.mlssoccer.com/post/2017/11/05/kak-makes-final-curtain-call-friendly-puerto-rican-hurricane-relief|title=Kaká makes final curtain call in friendly for Puerto Rican hurricane relief|publisher=www.mlssoccer.com|author1=Ian Quillen|date=5 November 2017|access-date=5 November 2017|archive-date=9 May 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190509175324/https://www.mlssoccer.com/post/2017/11/05/kak-makes-final-curtain-call-friendly-puerto-rican-hurricane-relief|url-status=live}}</ref>

===Retirement===
Kaká announced his retirement on 17 December 2017, after turning down offers from his former clubs [[São Paulo FC|São Paulo]] and [[AC Milan]]. He also expressed interest in working as a [[Director of football|director]], confirming that Milan had offered him a role.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://globoesporte.globo.com/programas/esporte-espetacular/noticia/kaka-anuncia-aposentadoria-e-diz-que-vai-estudar-para-ser-dirigente.ghtml|title=Kaká anuncia aposentadoria e diz que vai estudar para ser dirigente|trans-title=Kaká announces retirement and says he will prepare to become a director|publisher=Globoesporte.com|language=pt|author1=Marcel Merguizo|date=17 December 2017|access-date=17 December 2017|archive-date=18 December 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171218105803/https://globoesporte.globo.com/programas/esporte-espetacular/noticia/kaka-anuncia-aposentadoria-e-diz-que-vai-estudar-para-ser-dirigente.ghtml|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2017/dec/17/kaka-retires-football-age-35-milan-brazil|title=Former Milan and Real Madrid player Kaká retires from football at age of 35|publisher=Reuters|date=17 December 2017|work=The Guardian|access-date=19 December 2017|language=en-GB|issn=0261-3077|archive-date=18 December 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171218110753/https://www.theguardian.com/football/2017/dec/17/kaka-retires-football-age-35-milan-brazil|url-status=live}}</ref>

==International career==
===Youth career and early senior career===
Kaká was called up for the [[2001 FIFA World Youth Championship]], but the [[Brazil national football team|Brazilians]] crashed out to [[Ghana national football team|Ghana]] in the quarter-finals. Several months later, he made his debut for the senior Brazil squad in a friendly match against [[Bolivia national football team|Bolivia]] on 31 January 2002. He was part of Brazil's [[2002 FIFA World Cup]]-winning squad in Korea/Japan, but played only 25 minutes, all of which were in the 5–2 first round victory against [[Costa Rica national football team|Costa Rica]] on 13 June.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://kakafans.net/kakablog.php|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071016154138/http://kakafans.net/kakablog.php|archive-date=16 October 2007 |title=// Kaka's World Cup Blog – IN ENGLISH! |publisher=Kakafans.net |access-date=12 December 2010}}</ref>

In 2003, Kaká was the captain for the [[2003 CONCACAF Gold Cup]], where Brazil, competing with their [[Brazil Olympic football team|under-23 team]], finished as runner-up to [[Mexico national football team|Mexico]]. He scored three goals during the tournament.

===First Confederations Cup title and 2006 World Cup===
Kakà was included in Brazil's squad for [[2005 FIFA Confederations Cup]] in Germany. He appeared in all five matches and scored one goal in a 4–1 win over [[Argentina national football team|Argentina]] in the final.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.fifa.com/classicfootball/history/news/newsid=2653396/|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150710104628/http://www.fifa.com/classicfootball/history/news/newsid=2653396/|url-status=dead|archive-date=10 July 2015|title=Brazilian carnival climaxes Frankfurt festival|publisher=FIFA.com|date=29 June 2015|access-date=7 July 2015}}</ref>
[[File:Kaka.JPG|thumb|left|upright|Kaká training with Brazil prior to the start of the [[2006 FIFA World Cup]]]]
Kaká made his first [[FIFA World Cup]] finals start in [[2006 FIFA World Cup|2006]] and scored his first and only goal of the tournament with a 25-yard strike in Brazil's 1–0 victory over [[Croatia national football team|Croatia]] in Brazil's opener, for which he was named [[Man of the Match]].<ref name="MoTM">[https://web.archive.org/web/20090922145842/http://www.fifa.com/worldcup/archive/germany2006/news/newsid=11848.html Budweiser Man of the Match] – FIFA.com, 13 June 2006</ref> Kaká was unable to keep up the momentum for the remainder of the tournament, as Brazil was eliminated by [[France national football team|France]] in the quarter-finals with French star [[Thierry Henry]] scoring the winner.<ref>{{Cite web|url = https://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/world_cup_2006/4991616.stm|title = Brazil 0–1 France: Thierry Henry's superb volley sent holders Brazil out of the World Cup as France moved into the semi-finals.|date = 1 July 2006|access-date = 12 March 2015|website = BBC Sport|archive-date = 12 June 2018|archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20180612144528/http://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/world_cup_2006/4991616.stm|url-status = live}}</ref>

{{Blockquote|In 2006 he was part of the "magic quartet". Kaká and [[Ronaldinho]] in midfield, backed up by strikers [[Ronaldo (Brazilian footballer)|Ronaldo]] and [[Adriano (footballer, born February 1982)|Adriano]]. The team was top heavy and unbalanced, and forced to work back in midfield, Kaká paid the price.|[[Tim Vickery]] writing for [[ESPN]] on Brazil's disappointing 2006 World Cup.<ref name="ESPN 2018"/>}}

In a friendly against rivals Argentina at the [[Emirates Stadium]], London on 3 September 2006, after entering as a substitute, Kaká received the ball off a deflection from an Argentina corner kick and outran [[Lionel Messi]] while taking the ball down three quarters of the field to score.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.fifa.com/worldfootball/news/newsid=105920.html|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090708090328/http://www.fifa.com/worldfootball/news/newsid=105920.html|url-status=dead|archive-date=8 July 2009|title=New-look Brazil sink Argentina|date=4 September 2006|access-date=22 May 2009}}</ref> Exhibiting his "fantastic acceleration and balletic grace" (according to Carl Anka for the [[BBC]]), Kaká regards it as the greatest goal he ever scored.<ref name="Greats"/> On 12 May 2007, citing an exhaustive schedule of [[Serie A]], [[UEFA Champions League|Champions League]] and national team play, Kaká bowed out of the [[Copa América 2007|2007 Copa América]], which Brazil won.<ref>[http://www.wldcup.com/news/2007/05/20070512_42374_soccer_news.html Tired Kaká to skip Copa America] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070515064019/http://www.wldcup.com/news/2007/05/20070512_42374_soccer_news.html |date=15 May 2007 }} – World Soccer News, 5 December 2007</ref> After missing out on the Copa América, he returned to play in Brazil's friendly match against [[Algeria national football team|Algeria]] on 22 August 2007. On 11 October 2008, Kaká opened the scoring for Brazil in their 4–0 win against [[Venezuela national football team|Venezuela]] in a qualification game for the 2010 FIFA World Cup.<ref name="2008 Top5">{{cite news |title=Kaka's Top Five Goals Of 2008 |url=https://www.goal.com/en-us/news/86/italy/2009/01/12/1057647/kakas-top-five-goals-of-2008 |access-date=17 November 2021 |work=Goal |archive-date=17 November 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211117134731/https://www.goal.com/en-us/news/86/italy/2009/01/12/1057647/kakas-top-five-goals-of-2008 |url-status=live }}</ref>

===Second Confederations Cup title and 2010 World Cup===
Kaká participated in the [[2009 FIFA Confederations Cup]], wearing the [[Squad number (association football)|number 10 shirt]], marking his first international tournament since the 2006 World Cup. His only two goals came in Brazil's group stage opener against [[Egypt national football team|Egypt]] on 14 June, when he scored a goal in the fifth minute and then added a 90th-minute penalty in Brazil's 4–3 victory.<ref>{{cite news |url=https://news.bbc.co.uk/sport1/hi/football/internationals/8097813.stm |title=Brazil 4–3 Egypt |date=15 June 2009 |work=BBC Sport |access-date=30 June 2009 |first=Mark |last=Ashenden |archive-date=18 June 2009 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090618192657/http://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/internationals/8097813.stm |url-status=live }}</ref> Kaká also provided two assists throughout the tournament. He received the Golden Ball as the player of the tournament at the Confederations Cup and was also named the Man of the Match in the final after helping Brazil to a 3–2 win against the [[United States men's national soccer team|United States]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.fifa.com/confederationscup/news/newsid=1077806.html#top+awards+brazilian|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090701055634/http://www.fifa.com/confederationscup/news/newsid=1077806.html#top+awards+brazilian|url-status=dead|archive-date=1 July 2009|title=Top awards for Brazilian duo|date=28 June 2009|work=FIFA.com|access-date=30 June 2009}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |url=https://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/internationals/8120561.stm |title=US 2–3 Brazil |date=28 June 2009 |work=BBC Sport |access-date=30 June 2009 |first=Phil |last=Dawkes |archive-date=27 August 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190827183302/http://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/internationals/8120561.stm |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Kaká Fact File|url=http://www.espnstar.com/football/primera-liga/news/detail/item288496/Kaka-Factfile/|work=ESPNstar|url-status=usurped|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110721090409/http://www.espnstar.com/football/primera-liga/news/detail/item288496/Kaka-Factfile/|archive-date=21 July 2011}}</ref>

[[File:Brazil & Chile match at World Cup 2010-06-28 6.jpg|right|thumb|Kaká (left) playing for Brazil against [[Chile national football team|Chile]] at the [[2010 World Cup]]]]
At the [[2010 FIFA World Cup|2010 World Cup]] in South Africa, during the match against [[Ivory Coast national football team|Ivory Coast]] on 20 June, Kaká received a red card after receiving two yellow cards. The second card was given for an alleged elbow in the direction of [[Abdul Kader Keïta]].<ref>{{Cite web|url = https://www.theguardian.com/football/2010/jul/02/holland-brazil-world-cup-match-report|title = World Cup 2010: Holland knock out Brazil with spirited comeback|date = 2 July 2010|access-date = 15 March 2015|website = The Guardian|last = Williams|first = Richard|archive-date = 10 October 2015|archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20151010075829/http://www.theguardian.com/football/2010/jul/02/holland-brazil-world-cup-match-report|url-status = live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=2010 FIFA World Cup: Kaka's Wild Red Card Proves Need for Video Replay|website=[[Bleacher Report]]|url=https://bleacherreport.com/articles/409009-a-wild-red-card-on-kaka-we-need-video-replay-for-world-cup|access-date=6 September 2013|archive-date=14 July 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140714183713/http://bleacherreport.com/articles/409009-a-wild-red-card-on-kaka-we-need-video-replay-for-world-cup|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url = https://www.fifa.com/worldcup/matches/round=249718/match=300061507/index.html#nosticky|archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20100702014845/http://www.fifa.com/worldcup/matches/round=249718/match=300061507/index.html#nosticky|url-status = dead|archive-date = 2 July 2010|title = Dutch fightback buries Brazil|date = 2 July 2010|access-date = 12 March 2015|website = FIFA.COM}}</ref> Kaká ended the tournament with three assists in total, as the joint-top assist provider, although he failed to score a goal during the tournament. Brazil eventually ended up losing 2–1 to eventual runners-up [[Netherlands national football team|Netherlands]] in the quarter-finals of the tournament.<ref>{{Cite web|url = https://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/world_cup_2010/matches/match_57/default.stm|title = Netherlands 2–1 Brazil: The Netherlands produced a stunning second-half comeback to reach the semi-finals as Brazil's World Cup imploded in a dramatic game in Port Elizabeth.|date = 2 July 2010|access-date = 12 March 2015|website = BBC Sport|last = Bevan|first = Chris|archive-date = 1 July 2010|archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20100701190212/http://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/world_cup_2010/matches/match_57/default.stm|url-status = live}}</ref>

===Later career===
After more than a year absence from the national team due to a series of injuries, Kaká was recalled on 27 October 2011 for the friendly matches against [[Gabon national football team|Gabon]] and Egypt in November.<ref>[http://www.cbf.com.br/noticias/selecao-brasileira/2011/10/27/convocacao-do-mano Seleção Brasileira está convocada] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111029011304/http://www.cbf.com.br/noticias/selecao-brasileira/2011/10/27/convocacao-do-mano |date=29 October 2011 }}</ref> He later had to be removed from the squad due to a calf injury, and thus did not play either of the matches.<ref>{{cite news|title=Brazil's Kaka misses friendlies against Gabon and Egypt|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/15626159|publisher=BBC|date=12 October 2015|access-date=12 February 2018|archive-date=9 January 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160109211427/http://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/0/football/15626159|url-status=live}}</ref>
{{Quote box||width=27%|align = left |quote  = "The best player I have ever played with? That's Ronaldo, il Fenomeno. The other Ronaldo, Cristiano, probably makes my top five, but I have seen il Fenomeno do things nobody else has ever done." |source =—Kaká speaking in 2013 on his Brazil teammate [[Ronaldo (Brazilian footballer)|Ronaldo]] being the best player he's played with.<ref>{{cite news |title=Kaka: I prefer Brazilian Ronaldo over Cristiano |url=http://www.goal.com/en/news/584/brazil/2013/11/05/4384755/kaka-i-prefer-brazilian-ronaldo-over-cristiano |access-date=20 September 2018 |work=Goal |archive-date=20 September 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180920234408/http://www.goal.com/en/news/584/brazil/2013/11/05/4384755/kaka-i-prefer-brazilian-ronaldo-over-cristiano |url-status=live }}</ref>}}
After not appearing for Brazil in two years, Kaká was recalled on 28 September 2012 for the friendly matches against [[Iraq national football team|Iraq]] and [[Japan national football team|Japan]] in October.<ref>{{cite web |last=Etherington |first=Tom |url=http://www.sambafoot.com/en/news/36225_kaka__i_did_not_expect_brazil_recall.html |title=Kaká: I did not expect Brazil recall |date=28 September 2012 |publisher=Sambafoot.com |access-date=30 September 2012 |archive-date=1 October 2012 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121001092906/http://www.sambafoot.com/en/news/36225_kaka__i_did_not_expect_brazil_recall.html |url-status=live }}</ref> Following his recall to the ''Seleção'' squad, Kaká stated, "I admit it was a surprise this call&nbsp;... When the list was published, I was extremely happy. It was like my first call-up."<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.goal.com/en-us/news/3296/brazil/2012/09/28/3410006/kaka-elated-with-surprise-return-to-brazilian-national-team |title='Kaka elated with surprise return to Brazilian national team |publisher=Goal.com |access-date=30 September 2012 |archive-date=3 October 2012 }}</ref> Brazil coach [[Mano Menezes]] said that despite Kaká and [[Oscar (footballer, born 1991)|Oscar]]'s similarities, the two would be able to play alongside each other, as Kaká had slightly |url=http://www.sambafoot.com/en/news/36221_mano_menezes_believes_kaka_and_chelsea_s_oscar_can_play_alongside_each_other_for_brazil.html |title=Mano Menezes believes Kaká and Chelsea's Oscar can play Kaká retained his place in the squad for Brazil's 1,000th game in history, a 1–1 friendly draw against [[Colombia national football team|Colombia]] on 14 November 2012.<ref>{{cite web 2012 |access-date=21 February 2013 }}</ref>

On 5 March 2013, Kaká was called up by new Brazil coach [[Luiz Felipe Scolari]] for the first time since the coach's return, for [[Exhibition game|friendlies]] with [[Italy national football team|Italy]] in [[London]] and [[Russia national football team|Russia]] in [[Geneva]], both taking place late in that month.<ref>{{cite web |author=Sargeant, Jack |url=https://www.sbnation.com/soccer/2013/3/18/4119626/brazil-vs-italy-russia-team-news-squad-2014-world-cup-qualifying |title=Kaka included; Ronaldinho omitted from Brazil squad |publisher=SBNation.com |date=18 March 2013 |access-date=25 March 2013 |archive-date=22 March 2013 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130322174805/http://www.sbnation.com/soccer/2013/3/18/4119626/brazil-vs-italy-russia-team-news-squad-2014-world-cup-qualifying |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://sports.ndtv.com/football/news/item/205113-kaka-vows-to-earn-brazil-world-cup-berth |title=Kaka vows to earn Brazil World Cup berth |publisher=Sports.ndtv.com |date=19 March 2013 |access-date=25 March 2013 }}</ref> Kaká, however, was not selected for the national team for the [[2013 FIFA Confederations Cup|2013 Confederations Cup]] and was also omitted from Scolari's [[2014 FIFA World Cup|2014 World Cup]] squad.<ref>[http://www.cbssports.com/world-cup/eye-on-world-cup/24553498/brazil-names-23-man-world-cup-roster-ronaldinho-kaka-left-out "Brazil names 23-man World Cup roster; Ronaldinho, Kaka left out"] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150506180811/http://www.cbssports.com/world-cup/eye-on-world-cup/24553498/brazil-names-23-man-world-cup-roster-ronaldinho-kaka-left-out |date=6 May 2015 }}. CBS. Retrieved 24 May 2014</ref> After almost 18 months, Kaká was recalled to the Brazilian team in October 2014 by new manager [[Dunga]] for friendlies against Argentina and Japan.<ref>{{Cite web|url = In August 2015, he was called up to the national team once again for the team's international friendlies in September, and made a substitute appearance in Brazil's 1–0 victory over Costa Rica on 5 ==Style of play and reception==
[[File:Jersey of Kaka.jpg|thumb|left|upright|Kaká's [[AC Milan]] jersey in the [[San Siro]] museum]]
Widely regarded as one of the greatest players of his generation and one of the greatest midfielders in the history of the sport, Kaká has been described on the [[FIFA]] website as having the "capacity to glide almost effortlessly past opponents, provide defence-splitting passes and score consistently from distance."<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20090614023817/http://www.fifa.com/confederationscup/players/player=184312/profile.html "Kaka Profile"]. FIFA.com. Retrieved 7 June 2014</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2007/dec/17/newsstory.acmilan|title=Kaka named world's best player|newspaper=The Guardian|date=17 December 2007|access-date=18 December 2014|archive-date=18 October 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171018190703/https://www.theguardian.com/football/2007/dec/17/newsstory.acmilan|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://sports.ndtv.com/football/features/177868-lionel-messi-magic-captivates-even-football-legends|title=Messi magic captivates even football legends|access-date=18 December 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141218102914/http://sports.ndtv.com/football/features/177868-lionel-messi-magic-captivates-even-football-legends|archive-date=18 December 2014|url-status=dead}}</ref> In his prime at Milan and prior to the injuries he suffered at Real Madrid, Kaká was an intelligent, quick, and hardworking player that could [[Dribbling#Association football|dribble]] past defenders in one-on-one situations as well as during counterattacks.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://archiviostorico.corriere.it/2004/ottobre/25/Kaka_slalom_ammoniti_Maldini_non_co_9_041025078.shtml|title=Kakà in slalom: 4 ammoniti Maldini non sbaglia niente|publisher=Il Corriere della Sera|language=it|date=25 October 2004|access-date=9 December 2014|archive-date=26 December 2013|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131226114223/http://archiviostorico.corriere.it/2004/ottobre/25/Kaka_slalom_ammoniti_Maldini_non_co_9_041025078.shtml|url-status=live}}</ref><ref name="ReferenceA">{{cite news|url=http://www.repubblica.it/2004/a/sezioni/sport/calcio/classe/classe/classe.html?ref=search|title=Kakà, un predestinato alta classe brasiliana|newspaper=La Repubblica|language=it|access-date=9 December 2014|archive-date=14 December 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141214172301/http://www.repubblica.it/2004/a/sezioni/sport/calcio/classe/classe/classe.html?ref=search|url-status=live}}</ref><ref name="Matchett">{{cite web|url=https://bleacherreport.com/articles/2738922-the-forgotten-genius-of-kaka|title=The Forgotten Genius of Kaka|publisher=bleacherreport.com|author1=Karl Matchett|date=16 October 2017|access-date=18 October 2017|archive-date=17 October 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171017143357/http://bleacherreport.com/articles/2738922-the-forgotten-genius-of-kaka|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2006/jun/17/worldcup2006.sport7 |title=How privileged Kaka made most of luck to become Brazil's master of magic |newspaper=The Guardian |author1=Alex Bellos |date=17 June 2006 |access-date=1 December 2018 |archive-date=1 December 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181201093054/https://www.theguardian.com/football/2006/jun/17/worldcup2006.sport7 |url-status=live }}</ref><ref name="masterclass">{{cite web |url=https://www.fourfourtwo.com/us/performance/training/kaka-playmaker-masterclass |title=Kaka: The playmaker masterclass |publisher=fourfourtwo.com |last1=Fen |first1=Alec |date=3 January 2018 |access-date=23 April 2021 |archive-date=23 April 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210423225556/https://www.fourfourtwo.com/us/performance/training/kaka-playmaker-masterclass |url-status=live }}</ref> Regarding his speed and elegance on the ball during his trademark forward runs, in 2017, Karl Matchett of [[Bleacher Report]] stated:

{{blockquote|His gait, particularly when in possession, was mesmeric. Reasonably unusual in stature for a [[Playmaker|playmaking]] midfielder at a little over six feet tall, Kaká could still turn and accelerate past a defender in the same way the smaller, low-centre-of-gravity [[Squad number (association football)|No. 10s]] would manage—but that same elegant, long-legged stride made him unstoppable on the run.<ref name="Matchett"/>}}

[[Tim Vickery]] of [[ESPN]] wrote, "Kaká running forward with the ball had the power of a freight train. He married power with finesse". He also wrote on the impact of his knee and groin issues at Madrid, adding, "once his acceleration had been reduced, he lacked the subtlety to shine as before."<ref name="ESPN 2018">{{cite news |last1=Vickery |first1=Tim |title=Kaka's spectacular run with Milan and Brazil overshadowed by his successors |url=https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/37488436/kaka-spectacular-run-milan-brazil-overshadowed-successors |agency=ESPN |date=18 December 2017 |access-date=8 June 2018 |archive-date=12 June 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180612142032/http://www.espn.com/soccer/club/brazil/205/blog/post/3316565/kakas-spectacular-run-with-milan-and-brazil-overshadowed-by-his-successors |url-status=live }}</ref> Carl Anka of the [[BBC]] writes that his "knee and groin problems sapped him of the explosive half-yard burst he needed to navigate the corridors of midfield uncertainty", and that by 2009, he "was already on the wane."<ref name="Greats">{{cite news |last1=Anka |first1=Carl |title=Noughty Boys: Celebrating Kaka, one of the football greats of the 2000s |url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/bbcthree/article/5a94f5a8-b039-498d-8495-5fb2c29f3760 |access-date=23 October 2018 |agency=BBC |date=18 September 2018 |archive-date=21 October 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181021105222/https://www.bbc.co.uk/bbcthree/article/5a94f5a8-b039-498d-8495-5fb2c29f3760 |url-status=live }}</ref> Anka adds that because he was the last player to win [[FIFA World Player of the Year]] (in 2007) prior to the [[Messi–Ronaldo rivalry|Messi-Ronaldo]] dominance over the next decade, Kaká's standing and recognition in football has been "lost in a haze".<ref name="Greats"/>

[[Ronaldinho]] states, "For two, maybe three seasons [at Milan], he was the best player in the world. There was nothing he couldn't do", while his Milan teammate [[Andrea Pirlo]] adds, "There was a point when teams just had no idea how to stop him."<ref>{{cite news |title=Kaka - A Footballing Genius |url=https://www.beinsports.com/en/football/news/kaka-a-footballing-genius/1453896 |access-date=13 October 2020 |agency=Bein Sports |archive-date=19 January 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210119223254/https://www.beinsports.com/en/football/news/kaka-a-footballing-genius/1453896 |url-status=live }}</ref> Kaká was also renowned for his vision and passing, which allowed him to [[Assist (football)|create goalscoring chances]] for teammates.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://squawka.com/news/2013/08/30/should-arsenal-man-united-chase-this-south-american-super-star-transfer-scouting-report/2013083019442|title=Why Arsenal & Man United Should Chase This South American Superstar. Primarily an [[attacking midfielder]], Kaká operated as a [[trequartista]], and was also deployed in a free role behind the strikers.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://it.uefa.com/uefachampionsleague/news/01a9-0ea7b240d07d-79a78bae2b5b-1000--k-come/ |title=K come... |website=UEFA.com |date=9 May 2005 |language=it |access-date=19 June |last1=Murray |first1=Ewan |date=25 January 2020 |access-date=23 April 2021 |archive-date=15 August 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210815051301/https://www.90min.com/posts/6544390-kaka-the-brazilian-maestro-who-conquered-europe-and-beyond |url-status=live }}</ref> In 2023, ''[[FourFourTwo]]'' ranked Kaká ninth on its list of the 100 greatest players of the 21st century.<ref name="442 best 100"/>

==Personal life==
[[File:Kaka caroline.jpg|thumb|Kaká with then-wife Caroline Celico in 2007]]
Kaká married his childhood sweetheart Caroline Celico on 23 December 2005 at a [[Igreja Renascer em Cristo]] in [[São Paulo]].<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/southamerica/brazil/4286613/Seven-dead-and-dozens-injured-after-Kakas-church-collapses-during-service.html |title=Seven dead and dozens injured after 'Kaka's church' collapses during service |date=19 January 2009 |access-date=9 January 2009 |work=The Daily Telegraph |location=UK |first=Andrew |last=Downie |archive-date=22 January 2009 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090122021020/http://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/southamerica/brazil/4286613/Seven-dead-and-dozens-injured-after-Kakas-church-collapses-during-service.html |url-status=live }}</ref> The couple have two children, a son and a daughter.<ref>{{cite news | url=http://www.thedailystar.net/2005/12/24/d51224041745.htm | title=Kaka ties the knot | date=24 December 2008 | access-date=25 January 2011 | newspaper=Daily Star | archive-date=19 October 2011 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111019215401/http://www.thedailystar.net/2005/12/24/d51224041745.htm | url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://twitter.com/RealKaka/status/12517125235146752 |title=Tweet |quote=It's with great joy, that I confirm that my lovely wife @cacelico is pregnant of our 2nd child !! Now it's a girl !! |publisher=Twitter |date=8 December 2010 |access-date=9 January 2011 |archive-date=6 September 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230906173648/https://twitter.com/RealKaka/status/12517125235146752 |url-status=live }}</ref> In 2015, Kaká and Celico announced their divorce via social media.<ref>{{Cite web|title = Caroline Celico on Instagram: "Uma das decisões mais difíceis da nossa vida é escolher se queremos andar juntos, ou separados. Decisões que influenciam outros, que..."|url = https://instagram.com/p/50SJ_Oy3yZ/|website = Instagram|access-date = 3 August 2015|archive-date = 9 January 2016|archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20160109211428/https://www.instagram.com/p/50SJ_Oy3yZ/|url-status = live}}</ref>

Kaká married Carolina Dias on 30 November 2019,<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://f5.folha.uol.com.br/celebridades/2019/11/kaka-se-casa-com-carol-dias-em-luxuosa-cerimonia-na-praia-de-itacare-na-bahia.shtml|title=Kaká se casa com Carol Dias em luxuosa cerimônia na praia de Itacaré, na Bahia|date=30 November 2019|website=F5}}</ref> and the couple has two daughters.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://f5.folha.uol.com.br/celebridades/2020/10/nasce-filha-de-kaka-e-carol-dias-nao-tenho-palavras-para-descrever-esse-amor.shtml|title=Nasce filha de Kaká e Carol Dias: 'Não tenho palavras para descrever esse amor'|date=8 October 2020|website=F5}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://revistaquem.globo.com/noticias/noticia/2023/02/carol-dias-da-a-luz-sarah-segunda-filha-com-kaka-pegou-todos-de-surpresa.ghtml|title=Carol Dias dá à luz Sarah, segunda filha com Kaká: 'Pegou todos de surpresa'|date=13 February 2023|website=Quem}}</ref>

In 2024, rumors about the reasons behind his divorce from Caroline Celico began to emerge, alleging that Celico divorced Kaká because he was supposedly "too perfect".<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.thesun.co.uk/sport/27296847/kaka-brazil-caroline-celico/|title=My Ballon d’Or winning ex-husband was a very good person says stunning model who opens up on divorce from superstar|date=13 April 2024}}</ref> That's because, on 13 April 2024, Celico gave an interview to British newspaper [[The Sun (United Kingdom)|The Sun]] about the divorce, with the newspaper subtitling one of the pictures as: "Caroline said she split from Kaká because he was ‘too perfect’", and the phrase "Kaká was too perfect" became viral. However, Celico has always and repeatedly denied saying that phrase.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.cnnbrasil.com.br/pop/carol-celico-comenta-suposta-afirmacao-que-kaka-era-perfeito-demais/|title=Carol Celico comenta suposta afirmação que Kaka era "perfeito demais"|date=21 December 2024|website=CNN Brasil}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://gshow.globo.com/cultura-pop/famosos/noticia/carol-celico-nega-que-tenha-se-separado-de-kaka-por-ser-perfeito-e-aciona-justica-fui-muito-xingada.ghtml|title=Carol Celico nega que tenha se separado de Kaká por 'ser perfeito' e aciona Justiça: 'Fui muito xingada'|date=28 May 2026|website=gshow}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.estadao.com.br/emais/gente/ex-de-kaka-carol-celico-nega-ter-se-separado-do-ex-jogador-por-ele-ser-perfeito-demais-assista-nprec/|title=Ex de Kaká, Carol Celico nega ter se separado do ex-jogador por ele ser ‘perfeito demais’; assista|website=Estadão}}</ref>

Kaká gained [[Italian citizenship]] on 12 February 2007.<ref>[http://english.people.com.cn/200702/13/eng20070213_349678.html Brazilian Kaká gets Italian citizenship] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071027072837/http://english.people.com.cn/200702/13/eng20070213_349678.html |date=27 October 2007 }} – People's Daily Online, 13 February 2007</ref> He featured in many  [[Adidas]] advertisements. He also has a modeling contract with [[Giorgio Armani|Armani]], which prevented him from appearing in a photo collection of Milan players that was published by Armani's rival, [[Dolce & Gabbana]], in 2007.<ref>[http://www.glamourmagazine.co.uk/celebrity/celebrity-galleries/2013/09/sexiest-hottest-footballers-of-all-time#!image-number=21 "Hottest Footballers of all time. #21. Kaka"] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160703162054/http://www.glamourmagazine.co.uk/celebrity/celebrity-galleries/2013/09/sexiest-hottest-footballers-of-all-time#!image-number=21 |date=3 July 2016 }}. Glamour Magazine. Retrieved 7 June 2014</ref>

Kaká featured on the cover of the Italian edition of [[EA Sports]]' [[FIFA (video game series)|''FIFA'' video game]] ''[[FIFA 07]]'', alongside teammate and global star  [[Ronaldinho]];<ref>{{cite web|title=FIFA 07|url=http://allfifa.weebly.com/fifa-07.html|website=allfifa.weebly.com|access-date=25 April 2015|archive-date=6 July 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150706061830/http://allfifa.weebly.com/fifa-07.html|url-status=live}}</ref> he also featured on the covers of regional editions of ''[[FIFA 11]]'',<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.independent.co.uk/life-style/gadgets-and-tech/fifa-11-launches-worldwide-with-ten-different-covers-2094613.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20101001211840/http://www.independent.co.uk/life-style/gadgets-and-tech/fifa-11-launches-worldwide-with-ten-different-covers-2094613.html |url-status=dead |archive-date=1 October 2010 |title='FIFA 11' launches worldwide with ten different covers |newspaper=The Independent |date=1 October 2010 |access-date=18 May 2014}}</ref> ''[[FIFA 12]]'',<ref>{{cite web|author1=Eddie Makuch|title=Rooney, Kaka named FIFA 12 global cover stars|url=http://www.gamespot.com/articles/rooney-kaka-named-fifa-12-global-cover-stars/1100-6326371/|website=gamespot.com|access-date=25 April 2015|date=1 August 2011|archive-date=9 January 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160109211427/http://www.gamespot.com/articles/rooney-kaka-named-fifa-12-global-cover-stars/1100-6326371/|url-status=live}}</ref> and ''[[FIFA 16]]''.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.mlssoccer.com/news/article/2015/09/22/ea-sports-fifa-16-finally-stores-find-out-who-made-mls-custom-cover|title=EA Sports FIFA 16 is finally in stores! Find out who made the MLS custom cover|publisher=MLS Soccer|date=22 September 2015|access-date=23 September 2015|archive-date=24 September 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150924225249/http://www.mlssoccer.com/news/article/2015/09/22/ea-sports-fifa-16-finally-stores-find-out-who-made-mls-custom-cover|url-status=dead}}</ref> He was one of the [[FIFA 20#Ultimate Team|Ultimate Team Icons]] in ''[[FIFA 20]].''<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.ea.com/games/fifa/fifa-20/ultimate-team/fut-icons |title=FIFA 20 FUT Icons |date=20 September 2018 |publisher=EA.com |access-date=19 March 2020 |archive-date=8 November 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191108040744/https://www.ea.com/games/fifa/fifa-20/ultimate-team/fut-icons |url-status=live }}</ref>

[[File:Ronaldinho, Beckham, Kaka, Ancelotti.jpg|thumb|left|Kaká (second from right) at Milan with [[Ronaldinho]] and [[David Beckham]] to his right in 2009. The three players have a large fan base on social media.<ref name="so media"/>]]
Kaká named [[Raí]], the former Brazilian national team and São Paulo FC captain, as his footballing role model.<ref>{{cite news|title=Kaká: A dream come true |url=https://www.fifa.com/classicfootball/awards/gala/news/newsid=663469.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071218205144/http://www.fifa.com/classicfootball/awards/gala/news/newsid=663469.html |url-status=dead |archive-date=18 December 2007 |work=FIFA |date=17 December 2007 |access-date=25 January 2011 }}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Kaká leads a Brazilian celebration |first=Rob |last=Hughes |url=https://www.nytimes.com/2007/12/18/sports/18iht-SOCCER.html |newspaper=The New York Times |date=18 December 2007 |access-date=25 January 2011 |archive-date=22 December 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171222051608/http://www.nytimes.com/2007/12/18/sports/18iht-SOCCER.html |url-status=live }}</ref> He is best friends with former professional footballer [[Marcelo Saragosa]], as they served as the [[best man]] at each other's weddings.<ref>{{cite web |title=FC Dallas Updates: AC Milan or Liverpool? |publisher=Blogger |date=22 May 2007 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070911084241/http://worldcupway.blogspot.com/2007/05/ac-milan-or-liverpool.html |archive-date=11 September 2007|url=http://worldcupway.blogspot.com/2007/05/ac-milan-or-liverpool.html }}</ref> He is also close friends with Colombian striker [[Radamel Falcao]].<ref>{{cite web |last=Gleeson |first=Patrick |url=http://www.goal.com/en-us/news/82/south-america/2012/11/12/3523627/kaka-hails-falcao-ahead-of-brazil-colombia-friendly |title=Kaka hails Falcao ahead of Brazil-Colombia friendly |publisher=Goal.com |date=12 November 2012 |access-date=14 November 2012 |archive-date=17 November 2012 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121117144132/http://www.goal.com/en-us/news/82/south-america/2012/11/12/3523627/kaka-hails-falcao-ahead-of-brazil-colombia-friendly |url-status=live }}</ref>

In April 2012, Kaká became the first sportsperson to amass ten million followers on [[Twitter]].<ref name= "10 Million" /> In March 2015, Kaká had the fifth-highest social media following among athletes, with 33 million [[Facebook]] fans, behind [[Cristiano Ronaldo]], [[Lionel Messi]], [[David Beckham]], and [[Neymar]].<ref name="so media">{{cite news|title=Cristiano Ronaldo overtakes Shakira as Facebook's most 'liked' person|url=https://uk.news.yahoo.com/cristiano-ronaldo-overtakes-shakira-as-facebook-s-most--liked-person-085815659-soccer.html?pt=1/|publisher=Yahoo.com|date=10 February 2017|access-date=10 February 2017|archive-date=11 February 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170211075400/https://uk.news.yahoo.com/cristiano-ronaldo-overtakes-shakira-as-facebook-s-most--liked-person-085815659-soccer.html?pt=1%2F|url-status=live}}</ref>

[[File:Kaka boots.jpg|thumb|right|A pair of Kaká's [[Adidas]] boots, with a declaration of his Christian faith. In his [[goal celebration]]s Kaká invariably points towards the skies to express gratitude to [[God]].<ref name="Thanks">{{cite news |title=Kaka profile |url=https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12027/2374557/kaka-profile |access-date=9 October 2018 |agency=Sky Sports |archive-date=20 December 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191220232106/https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12027/2374557/kaka-profile |url-status=live }}</ref>]]

Kaká became an [[evangelical]] Christian at the age of 12: "I learnt that it is faith that decides whether something will happen or not." He removed his jersey to reveal an "I Belong to Jesus" T-shirt and openly engaged in prayers after Brazil's 2002 World Cup triumph, as well as Milan's 2004 ''Scudetto'' and Milan's 2007 Champions League triumphs. He also had the same phrase, along with "God Is Faithful", stitched onto the tongues of his boots.<ref name="Mitten">{{cite news |last=Mitten |first=Andy |url=https://www.independent.co.uk/sport/football/world-cup/the-golden-boy-of-a-golden-team-481010.html |title=The golden boy of a golden team |access-date=15 June 2010 |newspaper=[[The Independent]] |location=London |date=4 June 2006 |archive-date=6 September 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230906173657/https://www.independent.co.uk/sport/football/international/the-golden-boy-of-a-golden-team-481010.html |url-status=live }}</ref> During the celebration after Brazil's 4–1 win over Argentina in the [[2005 FIFA Confederations Cup|2005 Confederations Cup]] final, he and several of his teammates wore T-shirts that read "Jesus Loves You" in various languages. While receiving the FIFA World Footballer of the Year award in 2007, he said that initially, he just wanted to be a professional player for São Paulo and play one game for the Brazil national team, but that "God gave [him] more than he ever asked for."<ref>{{cite news|url=https://news.bbc.co.uk/sport1/hi/football/7121175.stm|work=BBC News|title=Kaka wins Fifa world player crown|date=17 December 2007|access-date=26 October 2011|archive-date=13 April 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180413130310/http://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/7121175.stm|url-status=live}}</ref> His [[goal celebration]] is him pointing to the sky as a tribute to God.<ref name="Thanks"/> Kaká's favourite music genre is gospel<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.rickykaka.com/en/index.php?function=show_all&no=120 |title=Public Chat Session |access-date=26 December 2006 |publisher=RickyKaka.com |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070927075229/http://www.rickykaka.com/en/index.php?function=show_all&no=120 |archive-date=27 September 2007 |url-status=dead}}</ref> and his favourite book is the [[Bible]].<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20070504014149/http://www.telegraph.co.uk/sport/main.jhtml?xml=/sport/2007/05/02/sfnkak02.xml Milan put their faith in Kaka] – The Telegraph, 5 February 2007</ref> In a 2006 interview with the Brazilian newspaper ''[[O Globo]]'', Kaká announced that he wanted to become an evangelical pastor.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.evangelici.net/notizie/1164009608.html|title=Kakà: "Io, futuro pastore evangelico"|date=20 November 2006|language=it|access-date=11 May 2017|archive-date=13 September 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170913135657/http://www.evangelici.net/notizie/1164009608.html|url-status=live}}</ref>

He was a member of [[Igreja Renascer em Cristo]] until 2010, then became a member of another church whose name has not been disclosed for reasons of confidentiality.<ref>{{cite web |author= Lívia Carvalho |title= Esposa de Kaká expõe motivo para não revelar igreja que eles frequentam |url=https://caras.com.br/atualidades/esposa-de-kaka-expoe-motivo-para-nao-revelar-igreja-que-eles-frequentam.phtml |date= June 6, 2025 |work= caras.com.br }}</ref>

Since November 2004, Kaká has served as an Ambassador Against Hunger for the [[United Nations]]' [[World Food Programme]], and he was youngest to do so in 2004.<ref name="WFP-30Nov2004" /> In August 2015, Kaká announced he would attend [[Full Sail University]] in [[Winter Park, Florida]] and major in [[Sports marketing|Sports Marketing]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.themaneland.com/2015/8/5/9102209/kaka-to-miss-clash-with-toronto-fc|title=Kakà to Miss Clash with Toronto FC|author=Sean Rollins|work=The Mane Land|date=5 August 2015|access-date=5 August 2015|archive-date=26 October 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211026022218/https://www.themaneland.com/2015/8/5/9102209/kaka-to-miss-clash-with-toronto-fc|url-status=dead}}</ref> Kaká was one of several Brazilian footballers to support [[Jair Bolsonaro]] in the [[Brazilian presidential election, 2018|2018 Brazilian presidential election]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Brazilian right wingers: Jair Bolsonaro pulls out politically reticent football stars |url=https://indianexpress.com/article/sports/football/brazilian-right-wingers-jair-bolsonaro-pulls-out-politically-reticent-football-stars-5369280/ |access-date=18 October 2018 |work=The Indian Express |date=22 September 2018 |archive-date=17 October 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181017120044/https://indianexpress.com/article/sports/football/brazilian-right-wingers-jair-bolsonaro-pulls-out-politically-reticent-football-stars-5369280/ |url-status=live }}</ref>
